name: Novel-view Synthesis
protocol: source video + absolute source and target camera (Kubric world frame, cameras look at (0,0,1)) -> the same 60 frames rendered from the static target camera. Source is the high view v0 of each scene (azimuth 0, elevation 45 degrees); targets are low-ring views (elevation 5 degrees) at +-15 / +-105 / +-165 degrees of azimuth (small / medium / large: 42 / 97 / 128 degrees of total viewpoint change). All baselines get the same cameras in their own format.
output: a 60-frame 576x384 video from the target camera
scoring: appearance: PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS over all 60 frames against the target view; state: per-object mask IoU, centroid trajectory error and object persistence against the target view's instance segmentation; every metric is reported per angle bin
